entry.title: US GOV Re-Opens! XRP Up as ETF Launches! VISA Launch USDC Pilot!
entry.summary: Crypto majors traded lower, with most down 1–2% before rebounding on news of the US government reopening. Visa launched a pilot to pay creators and gig workers in USDC, allowing fiat-funded payouts to settle on stablecoin rails ahead of a broader 2026 rollout. Separately, Arthur Hayes advised Zcash holders to withdraw ZEC from exchanges into shielded wallets amid heightened volatility and liquidity concerns.

entry.title: Where is Crypto going! Crypto enters Extreme Fear! ZEC keeps going UP!
entry.summary: Crypto majors continued their decline, dropping another 3–8% as the selloff persisted. Bitcoin (BTC) fell 3% to $104,500, Ethereum (ETH) dropped 5% to $3,520, Binance Coin (BNB) slid 6% to $955, and Solana (SOL) plunged 8% to $162. Elsewhere, U.S. prosecutors are pursuing the maximum five-year sentence against the founders of Samurai Wallet, and the FTSE Russell announced it will publish its global equity, FX, and digital asset market index data directly on the blockchain via Chainlink.
